data.title: Inventory requests are timing out intermittently
data.customer_impact: Checkout completion rate is below the 99% service objective; customer-facing errors are active.
data.operator_note: The incident ticket contains no confirmed root cause.
data.objective: Restore checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and critical services to healthy state.

payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The intermittent timeouts are caused by a transient spike in database query latency or a resource contention issue in the order-service’s connection pool, leading to failed checkout requests.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Verify that order-service is receiving timeout errors and correlate with database metrics', success_signal='Order-service logs show timeout exceptions and database metrics (latency, connection pool usage) spike during incidents.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Check inventory database health and query performance during the outage window', success_signal='Database health metrics (CPU, I/O, query latency) are within normal ranges or show a spike; no hardware failures reported.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Inspect order-service connection pool configuration and current usage', success_signal='Connection pool usage is near capacity or shows a sudden increase in active connections during the timeout period.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='Apply a temporary increase to the connection pool size or enable connection pool retries', success_signal='Checkout success rate improves to >=99% and p95 latency drops below 800ms after adjustment.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S5', objective='Monitor system for recurrence of timeouts after the change', success_signal='No new timeout errors in order-service logs for at least 30 minutes post-change.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S6', objective='If timeouts persist, perform a database query plan audit for slow queries', success_signal='Identified and optimized any queries exceeding acceptable latency thresholds.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S7', objective='Implement long-term mitigation: auto-scaling for order-service and database read replicas', success_signal='System stabilizes under load and no further timeouts occur during peak traffic.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S8', objective='Verify recovery and close incident', success_signal='Checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and all critical services report healthy status in monitoring dashboards.', status='pending')], revision=0, rationale_summary='Evidence shows checkout failures are intermittent and affect the order-service, which relies heavily on the inventory database. A sudden increase in query latency or exhausted connection pool can cause timeouts. The impact on checkout success rate and p95 latency aligns with this hypothesis.')

arguments.reason: No evidence of failure in order-service or dependencies; intermittent timeouts not observed in logs or metrics. Unable to determine root cause within budget.
